capabilities: Continue numbering automatically when pressing Enter at the end of a numbered line
Change numbering level with Tab and Shift+Tab
Switch between Gongwen, WeChat, Mail and Custom numbering presets from the status bar
Configure custom flat and hierarchical numbering templates with {cn}, {n}, {c}, {p} placeholders
Renumber or promote/demote the current numbering block via commands
disambiguation: Not a Markdown list formatter; it produces plain-text Chinese numbering that stays outside Markdown ordered-list syntax and survives export to Word or PDF.
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; tested only on desktop (mobile uses the same key logic but the status bar is invisible); README warns it conflicts with the Smart List Input plugin, which should be disabled; no network access or telemetry.
problem: Markdown rewrites Chinese numbering like 1、 into standard ordered lists (1. 2. 3.), so Chinese document numbering conventions are lost while typing.
summary: Typing assistant that writes Chinese-style numbered outlines (一、 1、 1.1、) with Enter continuation, Tab level changes, and four preset styles.
